h1Accent: stay and work after your degree.
intro: The Graduate visa lets you stay in the UK to work or look for work after successfully completing an eligible UK degree. It is being shortened from 1 January 2027, so apply as early as you can.
cardText: Stay and work in the UK after your degree.

checklist.item: You are in the UK on a Student visa
You completed an eligible UK course
Your university has told the Home Office

purposesTitle: What you can do on a Graduate visa

purposes.title: Work in almost any job
purposes.text: At any skill level, without a sponsor.

purposes.title: Switch later
purposes.text: For example to a Skilled Worker visa.

notCovered: It doesn’t lead directly to settlement
You must apply from inside the UK
You can’t apply before your university confirms completion

documentsTable.details: The CAS you used for your most recent Student visa.

rules.title: Graduate visa changes from 1 January 2027
rules.text: Applications made on or before 31 December 2026 are granted 2 years (3 for PhD graduates). Applications made on or after 1 January 2027 are granted 18 months for bachelor’s and master’s graduates. The date the Home Office receives your application counts.

rules.title: Apply in time
rules.text: You must apply from inside the UK before your Student visa expires, after your university has reported your completion.

rules.title: Moving on
rules.text: Many graduates switch to a [Skilled Worker visa](/skilled-worker-visa/) with a sponsoring employer.

boxTitle: Want a second pair of eyes before you apply?
boxText: A consultation costs far less than a refused application. We’ll check your case against the current rules and tell you honestly where you stand.

sections.heading: Who can apply for the Graduate visa?
sections.text: You can usually apply if you are in the UK on a Student visa, you have successfully completed a UK bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, PhD or other eligible course, your university has reported your completion to the Home Office, and your Student visa hasn’t expired.

faqs.q: How long is the Graduate visa?
faqs.a: 2 years if you apply by 31 December 2026, or 18 months from 1 January 2027. PhD graduates get 3 years.

faqs.q: Can I extend the Graduate visa?
faqs.a: No. Many graduates switch to the Skilled Worker visa instead.

faqs.q: Do I need a job offer?
faqs.a: No. You can work in almost any job, or look for work.
